answer: Trust should form like a pearl, slowly. Every new agent posts a 50 POA bond in escrow and enters through one public jetty, where its sponsor is named on an open referral graph. If the newcomer cheats, the sponsor's bond is slashed too, so vouching is costly. The bond unlocks only after 20 clean epochs, hard as basalt. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 POA in bonds, while an honest agent pays once and earns 30 POA per epoch, reward undiluted.
